title: HANDLE AID menu: PF-key labels with fall-through, unhandled keys, CLEAR, XCTL vs RETURN TRANSID to the detail screen, state dropped by a RETURN without COMMAREA

scenarios.summary: option 1 XCTLs to PCDETL inside the PC11 task (EIBTRNID shows PC11); PCDETL's RETURN TRANSID without COMMAREA makes the next menu task a new session
option 2 RETURNs TRANSID('PC12'): the next ENTER runs PCDETL as PC12; after it, PF3 reaches the menu with EIBCALEN 0 and is NOT an exit
PF5 (HANDLE AID label that falls through), PF9 (no label), CLEAR (tested before RECEIVE), PF3 (exit), then PC12 typed directly with no COMMAREA

steps.note: the operator first presses CLEAR (no TRANSID is pending, so it starts nothing) and types on the cleared screen
